Guillermo's own take for Sat, Nov 21 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Maybe Porteau. The outflow came back overnight: Pam Rocks read N 16 to 17 from 2am to 5am, gusting 22, and the English Bay buoy N 18. EC calls it building to 30 this morning, but the page has Pam Rocks near 17 at 8am and fading by 11.

If it builds, Porteau from first light, about 8am, to 11am. Low tide 9.8ft at 9am, then flooding to 14.6ft by 3pm, so the waves soften late.

Check before driving: Pam Rocks N 22+ at 8am. Squamish is outflow, skip it. Southeast builds in the Strait Sunday.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 04:00 PM PCT 21 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Sunday. Wind northerly outflow 15 knots increasing to northerly outflow 20 this evening then diminishing to northerly outflow 15 late Sunday morning. Wind increasing to northerly outflow 25 Sunday evening.
